nodes.label: Model B Per-User Household Auth
nodes.rationale: Households are per-user, scoped by household_members.user_id. The shared passcode was repurposed as an explicit superadmin escalation at /admin rather than dropped (superseding the earlier 'drop the passcode' plan): an explicit secret god-mode key is the owner's deliberate escalation while Google users are scoped. Sign-in fails closed in prod (empty allow-list denies all) unless the email already has a membership/invite.

nodes.label: Reads-via-Queries / Writes-via-Server-Actions Pattern
nodes.rationale: No REST API is needed for CRUD: Server Components call lib/queries for reads and Client Components call Zod-validated, household-scoped Server Actions for writes, so validation and household scoping live at one boundary and every mutation returns { error } for foreign ids.

nodes.label: Money as Integer Minor Units
nodes.rationale: Amounts are stored as integer minor units (expenses.amount_minor, fixed scale 100) so SQL sums are exact over integers; queries convert back with a single /100.0 at the boundary so components always see major units.

nodes.label: HMAC Passcode Access Gate
nodes.rationale: Cookie format v1.<issued-at>.<HMAC-SHA256 signature> signed with the Web Crypto API and expiring server-side after 30 days — deliberately no JWT library; the same helper runs in proxy.ts and the verifyPasscode Server Action.

nodes.label: DB-Free Production Build via force-dynamic
nodes.rationale: DB-backed pages export dynamic='force-dynamic' via the (app) layout so the production build never touches the database, renders per request against Turso at runtime, and works in CI without a pre-seeded DB.

nodes.label: Biome Auto-Format Footgun
nodes.rationale: The PostToolUse Biome auto-format runs after every edit: organizeImports strips an import added before its first usage, and useExhaustiveDependencies strips dependency-only effect deps (renaming the now-unused var), silently turning effects into [] deps. Fix: add imports in the same/later edit as their usage, and read dep values inside the effect body so they stay real deps.

nodes.label: App-Level Progress Bar + Route Skeletons
nodes.rationale: Deliberately NOT a catch-all (app)/loading.tsx — that double-skeletoned against pages that already have in-page Suspense skeletons; per-route loading.tsx was added only for the 4 pages with zero loading UI. Nav finish is a committed route-key change with a 4s safety timeout plus a mount-time reset so an errored nav can't leave the bar stuck.

nodes.label: Settle-Up & Balances Feature
nodes.rationale: Integer minor units, equal split over opted-in participants, balances sum to zero, greedy debt simplification for suggested payments. Known accepted edge: toggling a member out after a settlement involving them can make displayed balances not sum to zero — the include_in_settle_up toggle is retroactive by design.

nodes.label: Append-Only Activity Audit Feed
nodes.rationale: logActivity is best-effort and never throws so audit logging can never break a mutation; the feed is newest-first with a before cursor and day grouping.

nodes.label: SESSION_VERSION v1→v2 Invalidation
nodes.rationale: Bumping SESSION_VERSION mass-invalidates every pre-Model-B passcode cookie at deploy so no stale cookie silently becomes a superadmin session; the owner re-unlocks /admin once and family members re-auth via Google.

nodes.label: Decision: Stay on Turso/libSQL
nodes.rationale: Postgres is not required to add auth (Auth.js's Drizzle adapter supports libSQL); revisit only on a real scale/relational trigger.

nodes.label: Playwright webServer-before-globalSetup Fix
nodes.rationale: Playwright starts webServer BEFORE globalSetup runs, so seeding the e2e DB in global-setup raced the already-running server ('no such table: households', SQLITE_READONLY_DBMOVED after rmSync moved the file under the open libSQL connection). Fix: move the entire DB lifecycle (reset+migrate+seed) into the webServer.command so schema and seed exist before the server opens its connection.

nodes.label: Lazy libSQL Client During next build
nodes.rationale: The libSQL client connected eagerly at import, so env-less Vercel preview builds died with LibsqlError URL_INVALID. During NEXT_PHASE='phase-production-build' db is a Proxy constructing the real client only on first use — which force-dynamic pages never trigger at build; at runtime and in tests db stays the real eager client.
nodes.norm_label: lazy libsql client during next build

nodes.label: postcss >=8.5.10 Security Override
nodes.rationale: Forces the patched postcss everywhere (GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93: XSS in stringified output <8.5.10) because next and next-auth's transitive next still pin older; applying it required pnpm dedupe since plain pnpm install short-circuits and doesn't apply new overrides.

nodes.label: Household Membership Row Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: One household_members table serves three roles: auth membership (user_id set → access), pending invite (email set, user_id null → access claimed on next login), and attribution-only rows (name only) so people who don't use the app can still be tracked.

nodes.label: safeAction Server-Action Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every action: wrap in safeAction (throws logged and returned as { error }, redirect() passes through), validate with Zod, resolve the household, scope updates/deletes with and(eq(id), eq(householdId)) checking .returning() emptiness, convert money with toMinorUnits, then revalidatePath.

nodes.label: In-Memory libSQL Integration Tests
nodes.rationale: Integration tests run real Server Actions against an in-memory libSQL DB (DATABASE_URL=':memory:' via vi.hoisted) with the actual migrations; only next/headers cookies and next/cache are mocked.

nodes.label: Never Assert getByRole('alert') in e2e
nodes.rationale: The Next.js App Router renders a visually-hidden role='alert' route announcer on every navigation, so asserting on getByRole('alert') matches or races the announcer, producing flaky, misleading results — target the specific rendered text or element instead.

nodes.label: Passcode-Only Auth in e2e
nodes.rationale: Google sign-in requires a real IdP and is out of scope for e2e; tests use the shared-passcode path with HOUSEHOLD_PASSCODE=e2e-pass from playwright.config.ts's webServer.env.

nodes.label: Token-Only Styling Rule
nodes.rationale: No hardcoded colors, literal radii, or inline shadows — only semantic tokens (bg-card, rounded-2xl, shadow-card) so dark mode reaches parity through tokens and restyles never touch data fetching, Server Actions, validators, or query logic.

nodes.label: Fresh Ledger Design System
nodes.rationale: Light-first warm palette (cream --background, white --card, indigo --primary) with dark parity reached through tokens rather than per-component overrides; Plus Jakarta Sans display + Geist body; friendly-housemate voice; every rule documents only what actually exists in globals.css and src/components/motion/.

nodes.label: Motion Primitives (PageTransition, Stagger, MotionCard, AnimatedNumber)
nodes.rationale: Every primitive already no-ops under useReducedMotion(); shell chrome (FAB, active-tab pill) may use inline motion for layoutId shared-element transitions, everywhere else reuse the primitives instead of hand-rolling motion.div variants.

nodes.label: FEATURES.md Generator Skill
nodes.rationale: Grounds the end-user doc in the app's actual routes, server actions, and schema so it never drifts from reality; writes for end users with no file/framework jargon; never commits — the SessionEnd hook regenerates the file but leaves it as a working-tree change for human review.

nodes.label: Repo Working-Memory Practice
nodes.rationale: memory.md is the fast path to project context — read at the start of any non-trivial task before exploring code, updated after significant work; CLAUDE.md holds the durable rules while memory.md holds the evolving work log and open items; treat it as context, not gospel, and fix it when stale.

nodes.label: CI Job (lint / typecheck / test / build)
nodes.rationale: The build step runs with a dummy AUTH_SECRET and DATABASE_URL=':memory:' because force-dynamic pages run no queries at build time, but the libSQL client still opens its connection eagerly at import and the gitignored data/ dir doesn't exist in CI.

nodes.label: Non-Blocking e2e CI Job
nodes.rationale: Runs in parallel with no `needs` and continue-on-error because e2e is a signal, not a gate, while the suite is young; promote to blocking later by removing continue-on-error. Uploads the Playwright report only on failure.

nodes.label: Per-Household Currency Switcher Plan
nodes.rationale: Reformat-only (no FX conversion) — amounts are unchanged numbers, only symbol + grouping change. Currency lives per household on households.currency because the data model already has a household tenant; React Context (CurrencyProvider) avoids prop-drilling and preserves the formatCurrency(amount) call shape. Default INR with the en-IN locale for correct lakh/crore grouping (₹1,50,000.00).

nodes.label: Multi-Household Workspaces Plan
nodes.rationale: Workspace model (like Slack/Notion) behind the single shared passcode; per-user ownership deferred to the real-auth milestone. The he_household cookie holds the active household id, validated server-side, and is deliberately unsigned because it is not a security boundary. Because all data is already scoped by household_id, once getCurrentHousehold() resolves the active household every view isolates automatically.

nodes.label: Rename-to-Force-Compile-Errors Technique
nodes.rationale: Remove the old exported resolver (getDefaultHousehold) and rename it so the type-checker lists every one of the 12 call sites as errors until updated — guaranteeing completeness, since a missed resolution site would leak data across households.

nodes.label: Sign in with Google Plan (Model A)
nodes.rationale: Auth.js v5 with the Google provider, JWT sessions (stateless, keeps proxy.ts simple, no DB writes per request), no DB migration (users not persisted until Model B), and an allow-list signIn callback as the security crux since Google sign-in is otherwise open to any Google account.
nodes.norm_label: sign in with google plan (model a)

nodes.label: Model A Identity Layer
nodes.rationale: Passcode + Google coexistence is safe only because Model A applies no per-user access scoping — a passcode user and a Google user get the same access to the shared households. The 'passcode + Google = foot-gun' warning only applies once households become per-user (Model B), at which point the plan said the passcode must be removed (it was later repurposed as an explicit superadmin instead).

nodes.label: Mosaic O Logo Concepts (rupee currency variants)
nodes.rationale: Three variants keep the rose ring 'O' + cream tile background and differ in the expense-tracker signal: a single dominant rupee (cleanest at small sizes), rupee + dollar (signals multi-currency), or rupee + four saffron parapet-rhythm tiles (most personal to the home).

nodes.label: Fail-open Google Allow-list (S1)
nodes.rationale: One forgotten env var (empty HOUSEHOLD_ALLOWED_EMAILS) silently opens full read/write/delete access to any Google account; the fix is a fail-closed allow-list in production.

nodes.label: Constant Eternal Passcode Session Token (S2)
nodes.rationale: Cookie = HMAC(AUTH_SECRET, 'authed') is identical for every device, never expires, and is unrevocable except by rotating AUTH_SECRET; fixed by an expiring versioned payload v1.<issuedAt>.<sig>.

nodes.label: Household-unscoped Mutations (S4)
nodes.rationale: Every id-parameterized update/delete operated on the raw id, allowing cross-household data corruption. Authorization must live in the data layer (SQL where clause), not the deploy checklist; scoping mutations is the structural unblock for Model B.

nodes.label: Money as Integer Minor Units
nodes.rationale: Money stored as IEEE-754 real poisons aggregates ('1e308'/'Infinity' pass validation). Migrating to integer minor units is cheap now (one user, one local DB) and painful later — make invalid states unrepresentable while the dataset is trivially migratable.

nodes.label: Zero Tests, Zero CI (T1/O1)
nodes.rationale: A codebase with an aggressive refactor cadence and three late-caught bugs had no safety net; the remedy is to codify the checks already run by hand (lint, tsc, build, unit tests over gate/money/guards) — no ceremony beyond them.

nodes.label: Turso/libSQL Driver Migration
nodes.rationale: One driver (drizzle-orm/libsql) works for both local file: SQLite and cloud libsql:// Turso; the existing sqlite-core schema is reused unchanged, and better-sqlite3's filesystem assumptions do not work on serverless.

nodes.label: Shared Passcode Gate (Web Crypto HMAC he_session)
nodes.rationale: Single-tenant app: a shared passcode stops public read/write without the cost of full OAuth. Web Crypto (crypto.subtle HMAC-SHA256) is both Edge- and Node-safe so the same gate helper serves middleware and Server Actions with no JWT library.
nodes.norm_label: shared passcode gate (web crypto hmac he_session)

nodes.label: deleteMember Orphan-Records Guard
nodes.rationale: Deleting a member with existing expenses orphaned expenses.member_id; the guard mirrors the existing deleteCategory pattern and blocks deletion with an error instead.

nodes.label: Fresh Ledger Design Direction
nodes.rationale: Replace the flat, monochrome, serif-by-accident look with a warm, light-first family-app feel: floating white cards on a soft cream canvas, one indigo action accent, Plus Jakarta Sans display type, and a dark theme that is a tuned mirror on warm near-black rather than an afterthought.

nodes.label: Motion System (reduced-motion-first)
nodes.rationale: Motion is centralized in reusable primitives under src/components/motion/ rather than scattered; prefers-reduced-motion is a hard requirement — every primitive degrades to instant/opacity-only and no motion is load-bearing for usability.

nodes.label: Token-only Styling Convention
nodes.rationale: No hardcoded hex/rgb/radius/shadow in components — only Tailwind utilities resolving to @theme tokens. Token-only styling makes dark-mode parity mostly free and keeps every restyle consistent; a new value means adding a token in globals.css first.

nodes.label: Self-referential --font-sans Bug
nodes.rationale: globals.css declared --font-sans: var(--font-sans) (self-reference resolving to nothing) while the Geist loader used --font-geist-sans, so headings/body fell back to serif on the live app.

nodes.label: Repo Hardening Tracks (Biome, Playwright e2e, typed-env)
nodes.rationale: Adopt the mature engineering practices from ivm-pwa that fit Outlay (Biome replacing ESLint, mobile-first Playwright e2e, zod typed env, exact-pin dependency discipline) before any visual churn, so the redesign lands on a hardened base.
nodes.norm_label: repo hardening tracks (biome, playwright e2e, typed-env)

nodes.label: Biome Migration (ESLint replacement)
nodes.rationale: Landed as one isolated commit before the redesign so the one-time reformat/class-sort never pollutes later diffs. useSortedClasses is a nursery rule with an Unsafe autofix, so the rule level is set to error and --write --unsafe is required for sorting to actually apply; opinionated recommended rules that flag intentional pre-existing patterns are deliberately downgraded to keep the swap behavior-preserving.

nodes.label: Typed Env Module (zod, build-phase relaxed)
nodes.rationale: src/lib/env.ts is parsed once at import and transitively imported by the whole build graph, while the CI build sets only AUTH_SECRET + DATABASE_URL. Validation is therefore relaxed during NEXT_PHASE=phase-production-build (partial parse) and enforced fail-fast at runtime; empty strings map to undefined for optional vars because Vercel injects unset vars as ''.

nodes.label: Playwright e2e Scaffold (Pixel 7, seeded e2e.db)
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first single Pixel 7 project; globalSetup rebuilds a clean seeded file:./data/e2e.db by redirecting DATABASE_URL, and auth uses the passcode path only because Google sign-in needs a real IdP. The CI e2e job is parallel and non-blocking (continue-on-error) while the suite is young — a signal, not a gate.

nodes.label: Route-Announcer e2e Rule (never getByRole alert)
nodes.rationale: The Next.js App Router renders a visually-hidden role=alert route announcer on every navigation, so asserting getByRole('alert') matches or races the announcer and produces flaky results; a persistent .claude/rules file prevents reintroduction.

nodes.label: Motion Primitives (PageTransition, AnimatedNumber, Stagger, MotionCard)
nodes.rationale: Four reduced-motion-aware primitives created once in M1 with a barrel export so later milestones import from @/components/motion instead of hand-rolling motion.div variants; AnimatedNumber is TDD'd under a per-file happy-dom pragma while all other suites stay node-env.

nodes.label: Fresh Ledger OKLCH Token Palette + Shadow Tokens
nodes.rationale: Warm cream light palette and warm near-black dark palette in OKLCH, indigo primary, shadow-card/float/pop tokens and a friendlier radius base — all defined in globals.css @theme so components stay token-only.
nodes.norm_label: fresh ledger oklch token palette + shadow tokens

nodes.label: Font Wiring Fix (distinct loader variables)
nodes.rationale: A next/font loader variable must never share the name of the Tailwind token it feeds: each loader gets a distinct variable (--font-geist-sans/--font-geist-mono/--font-jakarta) and @theme inline maps --font-sans/--font-mono/--font-display onto them, ending the serif fallback and adding Plus Jakarta Sans for headings.

nodes.label: Design-System Skill + Path-scoped UI Rules
nodes.rationale: .claude/skills/design-system/SKILL.md codifies tokens, type scale, motion rules and voice so future agent restyle work stays on-brand; .claude/rules/ui.md auto-applies the invariants to src/components/** and src/app/**.

nodes.label: Sliding Mobile-Nav Pill (layoutId mobile-nav-pill)
nodes.rationale: The active bottom-nav item renders a shared-layoutId pill behind it so the indicator slides between items; the elevated indigo FAB uses whileTap spring, and everything degrades under reduced motion with safe-area padding and >=44px targets.

nodes.label: isNavItemActive Pure Helper
nodes.rationale: The Add item (/expenses/new) matches only exactly so it is not lit while browsing the list; every other item prefix-matches. Extracted to a pure helper and TDD'd because the sliding pill renders inside whichever item is active.

nodes.label: hero-total Stable e2e Selector Contract
nodes.rationale: The dashboard hero must expose [data-slot="hero-total"] as a stable selector because Plan 04's add-expense e2e asserts the dashboard total against it — a cross-plan contract locked in the README.

nodes.label: Swipe-to-Delete (shouldRevealDelete threshold)
nodes.rationale: Motion drag reveals delete past a 72px leftward threshold (pure TDD'd shouldRevealDelete helper), but a visible delete button always renders so reduced-motion and desktop users can delete without swiping.

nodes.label: FAB to Bottom-Sheet Shared-Element Morph (layoutId add-fab)
nodes.rationale: On mobile the nav FAB morphs into the add/edit bottom Sheet via shared layoutId="add-fab" (exactly one element may own the id at a time); desktop keeps the page route and Server Actions are untouched.
nodes.norm_label: fab to bottom-sheet shared-element morph (layoutid add-fab)

nodes.label: Switch-Household Isolation e2e
nodes.rationale: A Playwright spec proving that switching the active household flips the visible expense set (data isolation), running against Plan 01's seeded e2e DB; the seed fixture keys on the e2e DB filename.

nodes.label: a11y / Reduced-motion / Lighthouse Pass
nodes.rationale: The closing sweep verifies reduced-motion behavior, AA contrast, focus rings, and mobile Lighthouse Performance/Accessibility >= 90 on the dashboard — the redesign's definition of done.

nodes.label: Two-Principal Actor Model (getCurrentActor)
nodes.rationale: A single cache()d getCurrentActor() resolves every request to exactly one principal — superadmin (valid passcode cookie, checked first) or scoped user (Google JWT with session.user.id) — so authorization has one entry point instead of scattered checks.

nodes.label: household_members as Authorization Boundary
nodes.rationale: Everything funnels through three central resolvers (getCurrentHousehold/listHouseholds/switchHousehold) plus two id-taking household actions, so making only those actor-aware makes ~20 per-household call sites transitively safe — no per-call changes needed. Denied switches return generic 'Household not found' to avoid existence leakage.

nodes.label: Invite-by-Email, Claim-on-Login
nodes.rationale: Invites are just an email column on household_members claimed on the invitee's next sign-in (UPDATE ... SET user_id WHERE email = ? AND user_id IS NULL) — no tokens, no extra table, no email delivery; a membership row is one of auth-membership, pending invite, or attribution-only.

nodes.label: Passcode as Superadmin (/admin gate)
nodes.rationale: The owner wants a do-everything master key, so the shared passcode moves to /admin as a deliberate elevation (checked before the Google session) that bypasses all membership scoping, while Google users become the everyday, scoped path. Superadmin is anonymous — accepted for a family app.

nodes.label: SESSION_VERSION Bump v1 to v2
nodes.rationale: Bumping the token version invalidates every outstanding passcode cookie on deploy so family members' existing cookies do not silently become superadmin — only a fresh /admin unlock elevates.

nodes.label: Compute Balances on Read (Approach 1)
nodes.rationale: Balances are never materialized — computed on read from expenses plus settlements in integer minor units so they sum to exactly zero. Chosen so the future per-expense-splits model needs no migration of stored balances: only the share rule changes.

nodes.label: Equal Split over Opted-in Members (retroactive toggle)
nodes.rationale: No per-expense split is stored, so the current include_in_settle_up participant set applies retroactively to the entire history — accepted because in a family household the toggle means 'who shares costs', not a historical record. Remainder minor units are distributed deterministically by member id so shares sum exactly to the total.
nodes.norm_label: equal split over opted-in members (retroactive toggle)

nodes.label: settlements Table (recorded paybacks)
nodes.rationale: A recorded payback (from_member paid to_member) in minor units, kept separate from expenses so settlements never appear in spending charts or reports.

nodes.label: Append-only activity Table (audit feed)
nodes.rationale: actor_label and summary are denormalized so the feed still reads correctly after the referenced expense/member is edited or deleted, and renders cheaply with no joins; metadata is optional JSON headroom for future linking.

nodes.label: Greedy Debt Simplification (max n-1 transfers)
nodes.rationale: Split members into creditors and debtors, greedily match the largest debtor to the largest creditor, transfer min(|debtor|, creditor), drop whoever reaches zero — producing at most n-1 transfers as a pure, unit-tested function.

nodes.label: Best-effort logActivity Helper
nodes.rationale: Called after each successful mutation inside every instrumented server action; wrapped so a logging failure is console.error'd but never fails the user's mutation — an audit feed missing a line is acceptable, a blocked save is not.

nodes.label: Pure Balance-Math Functions (computeShares / computeNetBalances / simplifyDebts)
nodes.rationale: TDD'd pure functions in src/lib/settle-up/balances.ts: shares distribute the remainder one minor unit at a time by id order, nets equal paid minus share adjusted by settlements and sum to zero, and simplifyDebts zeroes everyone out in at most n-1 transfers.
